lines.zh: 淡蓝色的翅膀在林间一闪
lines.en: Pale blue wings flash between the trees.

lines.zh: 我飞得高，丛林的边在我眼下
lines.en: I fly high; the jungle's edge lies below me.

lines.zh: 我在两棵大树之间来回
lines.en: I cross between two great trees again and again.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的蓝在光里发白
lines.en: The blue on my wings pales in the light.

lines.zh: 我顺着上升的热气往上
lines.en: I ride the rising warm air upward.
I round the canopy where the wind is strong.
I glide down a long stretch.
My wingtips part the mist.
I fly along the tops of the vines.

lines.zh: 我飞过一片开着的白花
lines.en: I pass a spread of white flowers.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在很远的地方
lines.en: My shadow falls far below.
I slip through a leaf gap into the light.
I turn around a cross branch.
I fly slower than before.
I skim the canopy's rim.

lines.zh: 我顺着树干往下看一眼
lines.en: I glance down along the trunk.

lines.zh: 我停在树冠的一片叶上
lines.en: I rest on a leaf in the canopy.

lines.zh: 从这里能看见整片林子
lines.en: From here the whole wood is visible.

lines.zh: 风把我的翅膀推了一下
lines.en: The wind nudges my wings.

lines.zh: 我的蓝色在树顶上很显眼
lines.en: My blue stands out above the trees.
I fold my wings slowly.
Other insects fly up here.
I wait for a rising wind.

lines.zh: 我的触角朝着太阳的方向
lines.en: My antennae point sunward.
I spread my wings flat on the leaf.
A bird calls below.
I stand on the other foot.
I bend my antennae slowly.

lines.zh: 我从树冠上落下来看你
lines.en: I drop from the canopy to look at you.

lines.zh: 我的蓝色在暗处变成灰
lines.en: In shade my blue turns grey.
You look up from under the tree.

lines.zh: 我飞得比你的视线高一点
lines.en: I keep a little above your sight line.

lines.zh: 你绕了两圈，我一直在上面
lines.en: You circle twice; I stay above.
I settle on a cross branch.
My wings go translucent in the light.
I settle nearer than you expected.

lines.zh: 你的手抬到一半停住了
lines.en: Your hand stops halfway up.
I am not afraid; only unfamiliar.
A fold has been put in my wing.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下一段又稳住
lines.en: I drop a stretch and catch myself.
Ash is on my blue.
I press to a leaf and keep still.
I fold my wings and drop.
I rest on a leaf to recover.
There is a crease in my blue.
I rise a little crooked.
I press to the leaf and stay still.
My wings beat slower.

lines.zh: 底下的花有蜜，我看见了
lines.en: The flowers below have nectar; I can see.
I glide down a stretch.
No flower in your hand; I wait.
That scent comes from below.
I land, wings not yet folded.
I take one sip, not enough.
I lift off again and circle the flower.

lines.zh: 我绕了两圈才决定下去
lines.en: I circle twice before deciding to descend.
This flower has what I want.
I rest on the petal's edge and look first.
I blunder into the leaves.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我撞上枝
lines.en: I hit a branch as you look up.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被你的手碰到
lines.en: Your hand touches my wing.
My pale blue scales scatter.
Wing dust drifts down while you look up.
I move to another branch.
I bump once before your forehead.

lines.zh: 你的头发把我的翅挂住
lines.en: Your hair snags my wing.
I tug once, then fly free.
The branch sways where I struck it.

lines.zh: 一只淡蓝的从上面下来
lines.en: One of my blue comes down from above.
We stop at the same height.
Her blue is paler than mine.
We glide down the wind together.

lines.zh: 她的翅膀边缘有一道白
lines.en: Her wing edge has a white line.

lines.zh: 我们落在一根枝的两头
lines.en: We land at both ends of one branch.
She hovers half a breath above me.

lines.zh: 我们一起升高，谁都不落
lines.en: We climb together, neither landing.
Her white light flickers at the wingtip.

lines.zh: 我们飞过一个圆，回到起点
lines.en: We fly a circle back to where we began.
I drop and touch it with a leg.
It is on the leaf, and not a flower.
I cannot carry this thing.

lines.zh: 我用口器碰了一下就走
lines.en: I touch it with my proboscis and leave.
I circle it half a turn.
It has not moved.
I drop down with wings half open.
I grip twice with my legs.
It is too smooth; I give up.
I rest beside it.

lines.zh: 我从树冠上降到你的高度
lines.en: I descend from the canopy to your height.

lines.zh: 我的蓝在光里亮了一下
lines.en: My blue flashes in the light.
You are below the tree; I am on the branch.
I take a nearer branch.
I slide down a stretch from the branch.
My blue greys in the shade.
I stop still above you.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我已经在了
lines.en: I was already there when you looked up.
I can see you clearly without coming close.
I chose a branch near you.

lines.zh: 我一直在你头顶这片树冠里
lines.en: I stay in the canopy above you.
You walk; I shift with you.
The wind pushes me off a little.
I am in no hurry to come down.
I have not moved on this branch.
You circle the tree; I turn with you.
The wind gives my position away.

lines.zh: 我飞起来，又停在同一处
lines.en: I lift off and settle in the same spot.

lines.zh: 你的树影移到了我身上
lines.en: The tree's shadow has moved onto me.
I have not flown far.
I dive from above.
My wing sweeps your brow.

lines.zh: 我的腿在你头发里勾了一下
lines.en: My legs catch in your hair once.
I strike and climb at once.
I dive and strike your shoulder.
My wing beats against your ear.

lines.zh: 我的腿在你发间划了一下
lines.en: My legs rake through your hair.
I miss and land on the branch.
I try once more before leaving.

lines.zh: 这点分量你几乎察觉不到
lines.en: You would hardly feel this weight.

lines.zh: 我从高处的一片叶上起飞
lines.en: I take off from a leaf high up.

lines.zh: 我的蓝色在树冠里亮起
lines.en: My blue brightens in the canopy.
The wind is right; I spread my wings.
I fly up along the trunk.

lines.zh: 树顶的光落在我的翅上
lines.en: Light from the treetop falls on my wings.
I lift off from a canopy leaf.

lines.zh: 蓝色在枝叶间亮了一下
lines.en: The blue brightens among the leaves.
I rise on the warm current.
The wind above the wood is clean.

lines.zh: 我落在一片最高的叶上
lines.en: I settle on the highest leaf.
The fire's hot air throws me upward.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀使不上力，一直落
lines.en: My wings fail and I keep falling.

lines.zh: 水进了翅里，我浮不起来
lines.en: Water gets into my wings and I cannot float.

lines.zh: 爆风把我卷到林子外面
lines.en: The blast carries me beyond the wood.
Something grazes the back of my wing.

lines.zh: 那股力量把我的翅压住
lines.en: That force pins my wings.
Not enough nectar; two beats and I stop.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮树冠，我的翅全白了
lines.en: Lightning lights the canopy and my wings go white.

lines.zh: 树没有了，我的翅只在空里扇
lines.en: No trees left; my wings beat only emptiness.
